# Dr Heal Pain Cure Hospital

> Dr Heal Pain Cure Hospital is a leading pain management hospital in Bangalore, India, specializing in advanced non-surgical pain treatments for spine, joint, muscle, and chronic pain conditions.

## Website

https://www.drheal.in

## About

Dr Heal Pain Cure Hospital provides evidence-based, minimally invasive, and non-surgical pain management solutions. Our multidisciplinary team offers personalized diagnosis, treatment, rehabilitation, and long-term pain relief for patients suffering from acute and chronic pain.

## Primary Services

- Back Pain Treatment
- Neck Pain Treatment
- Knee Pain Treatment
- Shoulder Pain Treatment
- Sciatica Treatment
- Arthritis Treatment
- Joint Pain Treatment
- Spine Pain Treatment
- Chronic Pain Management
- Disc Bulge Treatment
- Slip Disc Treatment
- Facet Joint Treatment
- Sacroiliac Joint Pain Treatment
- Frozen Shoulder Treatment
- Tennis Elbow Treatment
- Heel Pain Treatment
- Muscle Pain Treatment
- Neuropathic Pain Treatment
- Cancer Pain Management
- Regenerative Medicine
- PRP Therapy
- Non-Surgical Pain Procedures
